title: Shadow in the Cache: Unveiling and Mitigating Privacy Risks of KV-cache in LLM Inference
authors: Zhifan Luo; Shuo Shao; Su Zhang; Lijing Zhou; Yuke Hu; Chenxu Zhao; Zhihao Liu; Zhan Qin
venue_full: Network and Distributed System Security Symposium
affiliations: Zhejiang University, Huawei Technology, Hangzhou High-Tech Zone (Binjiang) Institute of Blockchain and Data Security

problem_statement.en: Production LLM systems often transfer and persist large KV caches in plaintext, exposing token-correlated internal representations even when user–server traffic is encrypted. An adversary with direct cache access can reconstruct sensitive user inputs through algebraic inversion, cache collision matching, or instruction-based injection.
problem_statement.zh: 生產環境中的 LLM 系統經常以明文傳輸與持久化大型 KV cache；即使 user–server traffic 已加密，與 token 高度相關的內部 representation 仍會暴露。可直接存取 cache 的 adversary 能透過 algebraic inversion、cache collision matching 或 instruction-based injection 重建敏感使用者輸入。

key_innovation.en: KV-Cloak protects each KV-cache block with secret reversible matrix transformations and a one-time random permutation, then algebraically fuses part of the obfuscation into attention-layer weights. Legitimate inference reverses the transformation losslessly, while exposed caches lose stable algebraic and semantic structure usable by reconstruction attacks.
key_innovation.zh: KV-Cloak 以秘密可逆 matrix transformation 與 one-time random permutation 保護每個 KV-cache block，並將部分 obfuscation 以代數方式融合至 attention-layer weight。合法 inference 可無損逆轉該 transformation，而外洩 cache 不再保有可供 reconstruction attack 利用的穩定代數與語意結構。

key_improvements.en: KV-Cloak reduces reconstruction under all three proposed attacks to near-zero, random-noise-level quality while preserving plaintext-level MMLU and SQuAD accuracy. With operator fusion, it adds 15.41 ms/GB, or 0.45% of prefill latency, in the reported micro-benchmark.
key_improvements.zh: KV-Cloak 將三種所提 attack 的 reconstruction quality 降至接近零、等同 random noise 的水準，同時維持與 plaintext 相當的 MMLU 與 SQuAD accuracy。採用 operator fusion 後，其 micro-benchmark 額外成本為 15.41 ms/GB，亦即 prefill latency 的 0.45%。

reuse_metric.en: KV-Cloak preserves plaintext-level MMLU and SQuAD accuracy while reducing reconstructed text under Inversion, Collision, and Injection attacks to near-zero, random-noise-level quality.
reuse_metric.zh: KV-Cloak 維持與 plaintext 相當的 MMLU 與 SQuAD accuracy，並將 Inversion、Collision 與 Injection attack 所重建之 text 降至接近零、等同 random noise 的品質水準。
